items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Mantovani was there, yep, and we had a piano and I was made to take piano lessons

ctx.x: Mantovani was there, yep, and we had a piano and I was made to take piano lessons, but I really loved playing piano, so I took piano lessons from an early age, classical piano, from about age five for a few years. And after that really got into other things, and in high school took up the trumpet. And I really hadn’t heard any jazz at all, until one day, this was actually a day when there was a parade, and it was called The Fate, in the middle of our little town in California, which was called Escalon.
